I'll carefully compare the source text against the draft, hunting for signature passages that are absent, paraphrased away, or flattened.

**Key passages to check:**

1. "That certain sultanism of his brain..." paragraph — largely present but check detail
2. "This it is, that for ever keeps God's true princes of the Empire from the world's hustings; and leaves the highest honors..." — partially present but check
3. "For be a man's intellectual superiority what it will, it can never assume the practical, available supremacy over other men, without the aid of some sort of external arts and entrenchments, always, in themselves, more or less paltry and base." — check
4. "But Ahab, my Captain, still moves before me in all his Nantucket grimness and shagginess" — check "and shagginess" missing
5. "this episode touching Emperors and Kings, I must not conceal that I have only to do with a poor old whale-hunter like him; and, therefore, all outward majestical trappings and housings are denied me" — check
6. "never mind how much like an old Mesopotamian family these whalemen may, in some primitive instances, live together" — check

**Analysis:**

1. **"shagginess"** — "grimness and shagginess" → draft has only "grimness." Minor but characterful.

2. **"all outward majestical trappings and housings are denied me"** — This is a key voice moment. Draft: "I have only to do with a poor old whale-hunter." The "all outward majestical trappings and housings are denied me" is completely absent. This is voice-establishing, interpretively significant (Ishmael's narrator position on the epic tradition).

3. **"this episode touching Emperors and Kings"** — absent in draft. The self-conscious meta-narrative aside is erased.

4. **"and leaves the highest honors that this air can give, to those men who become famous more through their infinite inferiority to the choice hidden handful of the Divine Inert, than through their undoubted superiority over the dead level of the mass"** — This is one of the most philosophically distinctive and critically cited sentences in the chapter. The draft completely omits the "Divine Inert" passage and the "dead level of the mass." This is a major signature loss.

5. **"old Mesopotamian family"** — draft says "family-likeness," entirely erasing the distinctive Mesopotamian comparison.

6. **"Such large virtue lurks in these small things when extreme political superstitions invest them, that in some royal instances even to idiot imbecility they have imparted potency"** — draft: "thus baubles magnify even idiot imbecility" — severely flattened.

7. **"For be a man's intellectual superiority what it will, it can never assume the practical, available supremacy over other men, without the aid of some sort of external arts and entrenchments, always, in themselves, more or less paltry and base."** — draft collapses this to "needs external arts and entrenchments—paltry and base in themselves." The rhetorical shape is largely preserved but the "For be a man's intellectual superiority what it will" framing is absent.
